title: Implement index data model
description: Implement the data model for indexes, tracking which columns have indexes applied on each table.
acceptanceCriteria: Index is associated with the correct table in the model

evidence: Implementation: Index model upgraded from single columnId to composite columnIds with tableId association
src/types/diagram.ts: Index type changed to { id, tableId, name, columnIds: string[] }; createIndex(id, tableId, name, columnIds) factory
src/hooks/useDiagram.ts: addIndex takes Omit<Index,'id'|'tableId'> and sets tableId; removeColumn filters via !i.columnIds.includes(columnId)
src/serialization/diagramSerializer.ts: serializeIndex uses index.tableId and index.columnIds directly
src/serialization/diagramDeserializer.ts: deserializeIndex restores tableId and columnIds
src/components/TableNode.tsx: columnHasIndex, addIndex, startIndexEdit, saveIndexEdit, index list rendering updated for columnIds array + tableId
src/connection/schemaToDiagram.ts: composite columnIds + tableNode.id for index creation
Acceptance criteria verified: AC1 column(s) tracked via columnIds array (composite), AC2 indexes stored per table via table.indexes, AC3 table association via tableId field
